description: Use when you need South Korea's official public holidays for a year (business-day calculation, scheduling, settlement and payroll calendars). Data: KASI (Korea Astronomy and Space Science Institute) special-day register, incl. substitute and temporary holidays once promulgated. Input: year (YYYY, 2004-2100). Output: JSON list with date, weekday, Korean and English name, isPublicHoliday, kind. Example: ?year=2026 Price: $0.0027 USDC via x402.
name: kr_public_holidays
title: Korea public holidays for a year (KASI), English names
